_comment: WCH-Link firmware versions that fail in a measured way. One entry per (device, mcu, mode, version). Only measurements with a dated record go here; a version is not marked bad for a device it was not tried on. Read by pipeline/build/build_link_firmware.py into index/link_firmware_issues.csv.

issues.symptom: download --reset writes the flash and reports success, but the core stays halted (disable_debug_module: could not clear sw-breakpoint state: DtmOperationFailed); a wlink reset starts it
